business_summary: CARsgen Therapeutics Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in discovering, developing, and commercializing chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapies for the treatment of hematological malignancies, solid tumors, and autoimmune diseases in China. The company's products include Zevor-cel (CT053) for the treatment of relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. It is also developing autologous CAR-T product candidates, including CT041, which targets Claudin 18.2, is in phase II/III clinical trial for gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer and pancreatic cancer, as well as in phase I clinical trial for gastric or pancreatic cancer; CT011, which is in phase I clinical trial to treat hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC); and CT071, that is in Phase I clinical trial for the treatment of relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, relapsed/refractory primary plasma cell leukemia, relapsed/refractory plasma cell leukemia, and newly diagnosed multiple myeloma. In addition, it is developing CT0590 and CT0596, which target B-cell maturation antigen and are in phase I clinical trial for the treatment of R/R MM, PCL; KJ-C2219, which is in phase I for the treatment of B-cell malignancies, systemic lupus erythematosus, and systemic sclerosis; and KJ-C2320 for acute myeloid leukemia (AML) that is in phase I. Further, the company develops KJ-C2526, which is in the pre-clinical stage to treat AML, other malignancies, and senescence; KJ-C2527, which is in the pre-clinical stage to treat gastric cancer; CT1390B, which is in the pre-clinical stage to treat AML; and KJ-C2529, which is in the pre-clinical stage to treat B-cell malignancies. Additionally, it engages in drug research and development, manufacture and import and export handling business. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 CARsgen Therapeutics Holdings Limited는 중국에서 혈액 악성 종양, 고형 종양 및 자가 면역 질환 치료를 위한 키메라 항원 수용체 T(CAR-T) 세포 치료법을 발견, 개발 및 상용화하는 데 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사의 제품에는 재발성/불응성 다발성 골수종 치료를 위한 Zevor-cel(CT053)이 포함됩니다. 또한, 위암, 위식도접합부암 및 췌장암에 대한 임상 2/3상과 위암 또는 췌장암에 대한 임상 1상을 진행 중인 클라우딘 18.2를 표적으로 하는 CT041 등 자가유래 CAR-T 제품 후보물질도 개발 중이다. 간세포암종(HCC) 치료를 위한 임상 1상 시험 중인 CT011; 재발성/불응성 다발성 골수종, 재발성/불응성 원발성 형질세포백혈병, 재발성/불응성 형질세포백혈병 및 새로 진단된 다발성 골수종의 치료를 위한 임상 1상 시험이 진행 중인 CT071. 또한 B세포 성숙항원을 표적으로 하는 CT0590과 CT0596을 개발 중이며 R/R MM, PCL 치료를 위한 임상 1상 시험이 진행 중이다.
